summary: A high-performance Rust framework for serializing and deserializing data structures into formats like JSON, YAML, and binary.
usecases: Serialize Rust structs to JSON for API responses or configuration files.
Deserialize YAML configuration into typed Rust objects for application setup.
Enable efficient binary data interchange in embedded systems or network protocols.
ideas: Combine with Tauri or Actix-web to build full-stack Rust applications with seamless data persistence.
Use serde with custom derive macros to build custom serialization for game state saving or ECS architectures.
Integrate with async Rust frameworks to parse streaming JSON data without blocking the event loop.
